methods.label: Add opposite coefficients
methods.explanation: The coefficients of \(y\) are \(1\) and \(-1\), which are opposites. Adding the two equations eliminates \(y\), giving \(2x=10\).
methods.levelReason: Recognizing opposite coefficients and combining their terms are within Grade 7.
